quests.title: Arrive and settle
quests.goal: Choose where your office stands in Bern and land in it, where the desk opens your computer.

steps.text: Choose a plot for your office and see which institutes are near it.
steps.hint: Every place near the plot shows its address with the page it comes from.

steps.text: Land in your office and sit down at the desk.

quests.title: Find the right people
quests.goal: Ask for the expertise your project needs.

steps.text: Ask the Navigator in your own words.
Open the sentence that proves a result.

quests.title: Ask it differently
quests.goal: Ask the same need in German or French.

steps.text: Ask again in German or French.
steps.hint: Try 'Sensoren für Blutzucker' or 'capteurs pour le diabète'.

quests.title: Bring your project brief
quests.goal: Upload a project description and keep the matched experts with their evidence.

steps.text: Make a match report: every match keeps its sentence and source link.

quests.title: Visit an institute
quests.goal: Walk to a place and see who works there.

steps.text: Walk to an institute and open it.

quests.title: When nobody fits
quests.goal: See how the Navigator answers when no page supports a claim.

steps.text: Ask about a professor who does not exist.
steps.hint: The Navigator says 'no verifiable source' instead of guessing.

quests.title: Add a new source
quests.goal: Add an institution's website with one configuration file.
quests.coming: Adding a source does not report to the story yet; a new site is one file in sources/.

steps.text: Add a source in the sources admin.

quests.title: Grow in Bern
quests.goal: Find opportunities, connections and partners for your business in Bern, in any order.
quests.coming: Adding a lab or an expert to your network does not report to the story yet.

steps.text: Save a funding call, a service or a space for your business.
Add a lab or an expert to your network.
Keep a source or a document in your office library.
Send a message to a member of your lab or network.
Visit the garage and meet the models behind the Navigator.
